name: Polaris Data Centre
developer: Springfield City Group / Polaris Data Centre
notes: Queensland's largest data centre, located at Springfield Central in the Ipswich LGA; Springfield City Group says it developed Polaris at a cost of A$275m. Public pages describe N+2 high-availability design and carrier-neutral connectivity, but do not publish MW capacity.

name: Swanbank / BrisWest data centre proposal
developer: Unknown applicant / BrisWest industrial estate context
notes: Ipswich City Council Development.i application 12285/2026/MCU is for Material Change of Use - Warehouse (Data Centre), associated with lots at Swanbank/99999 Blackheath Road, and was in confirmation period when checked. PlanningAlerts separately lists 9000/2026/SPSR for General Industry (Data Centre) at 99999 Blackheath Road. BrisWest markets the Swanbank estate as suitable for data centre operations.

name: Isaac Energy Hub data-centre co-location opportunity
notes: QPM announced it had begun preliminary discussions with data-centre companies and would evaluate co-location opportunities at its Isaac Energy Hub/112MW Isaac Power Station near Moranbah. This is an announced opportunity rather than a committed data-centre build; capacity_mw is null because no data-centre load was published.

name: Logan multifunctional edge data centre program
developer: Logan City Council / Queensland Government / private partners under discussion
notes: Logan City Council's digital infrastructure program included work with public and private players to establish a multifunctional data centre in Logan, and later operational-plan reporting referred to a 5G lab as part of a multi-functional edge data centre and a MFEDC report for further funding. No public capacity or final build decision found.

name: Clarks Logan City Bus Service micro data centre
developer: Clarks Logan City Bus Service / BES Information Technology Systems / Eaton
notes: Eaton case study says Clarks Logan City Buses deployed an Eaton Micro Data Centre to consolidate servers, switching, backup and core operational systems at its Logan bus depot. This is enterprise micro-infrastructure, not a commercial colocation site.

name: Longreach Airport SmartCabinet mobile data centre
notes: Longreach Airport enclosed its on-premises servers in a sealed, climate-controlled Vertiv SmartCabinet described as an enclosed mobile data centre supporting CCTV, access control and corporate systems. This is internal operational IT infrastructure, not a hyperscale or colocation project.

name: EC21 Mackay
notes: Baxtel lists EC21 Mackay at 35 River St, Mackay, as an operational Edge Centres data centre in Queensland. A 2021 industry article said Edge Centres had four operational Australian data centres including EC21 in Mackay. Public MW capacity not found.

name: CHAPtech Mackay colocation data centre service
notes: CHAPtech advertises co-location in a secure data centre with high-speed internet and power systems, and lists its Mackay office at 12 Gordon Street. No published MW capacity or separate facility address found.
